scope: Numerical comparison of ten bounded real-audio excerpts (425 s total), not ten full-song passes. Baseline-v5 versus final-verified. Model outputs and unchanged timings are not independent acoustic truth.

privacy.literalWords: Only the ten video-selected word identities plus one frozen reference identity from Lyudy.
privacy.otherWords: Index, SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 text, Unicode code-point count, numerical timings/letter indices, confidence and diagnostic codes only.
excluded: test/performance results still under separate review

timingConventions.secondsRelativeTo: The unchanged source excerpt, unless explicitly marked source-song seconds.
timingConventions.textHashEncoding: UTF-8, exact original case and punctuation, no normalization
timingConventions.soundingIntervalScreen: Alphanumeric Unicode code points except soft/hard signs; next sounding letter start or word end. This is a grapheme diagnostic, not a phoneme recognizer.
timingConventions.storedCharacterIntervalScreen: Every stored Unicode code-point interval, including silent signs; next stored letter start or word end. The one remaining zero interval is an unchanged silent sign in tnmk_berezen wordIndex 18, letterIndex 8; it is not a sounding interval.
timingConventions.confidenceMeaning: Existing alignment/model confidence, not calibrated independent correctness probability.

acousticReferenceEvaluation.scope: Three uncertain independent waveform/STFT reference ranges, not exact phonetic labels or manual listening. Compare distance outside a range, not claimed point-ground-truth error.

interpretationLimits: Unchanged intervals establish stability only; they are not scored as accurate.
Zero-duration grapheme intervals disappearing does not establish phone-level timing accuracy.
ASR disagreements and short/long interval screenings remain candidates, not proven errors.
Strong pitch means existing stabilized CREPE observations with confidence >= 0.5 and audioActive not false; no independent pitch ground truth exists.

Owned-note counts can change when the same measured melody is clipped/reassigned at corrected word boundaries; zero lost strong points is not a claim that every interpolated target frame is identical.
Three 5ms common-pitch target frames differ through existing clipped-contour interpolation; supporting numerical explanations are included. At the 10ms grid none differ.
No test completion or full-pipeline performance claim is made by this numerical evidence export.
